The characteristic polynomial and root residue give exponential correlation control uniformly in Fourier index; algebraic cancellation yields the positive quadratic spectral density and its unique extremal positions. The standalone finite checker passed 553 exact/numerical tests. Tests supplement, never replace, these analytic proofs.
